persona: Fresh independent ordinary fullcandidate Rust LSP source auditor; designated security review remains separate.
scope: Audit the FULL current eight-file candidate for ordinary developer/toolchain/code/API/normal-diagnostic correctness against original design/root adoption and Rust guidelines. Review actual public dispatch/check routing, parser/diagnostic source and the actual metadata graph. Check complete normal author fixture/readback source and compare independently frozen L12 scope without changing it. Source-only; delegate every framing/allocation/storage/lifecycle SECURITY judgment to the designated separate fallback review. Return exact source requests or qualified opinion and actual read coverage. No blanket approval from the earlier design votes or API table.
rateLimitDiagnosticScope: Only top-level event counts and allowlisted rate_limit_info.status enum values; no provider text, partial output or private details.
providerMetadataQualification: topLevelProviderMetadata contains only provider-envelope system/init/result fields. Recursive actualProviderMetadata may include names in quoted source/tool results and is not sufficient by itself for identity qualification.
exportPolicy: Only whole schema-valid objects; bounded U+2026 previews are excluded by multiple truncated fields or an exact summary-prefix continuation in another whole candidate. Every whole candidate is preserved; no partial content exported.
